troll-orc.label: Slay Troll mace (+1 damage) against Slay Orc mace
troll-orc.explanation: A level-30 Warrior whose deepest level is 50 carries two spare maces that differ only in the slay: one of Slay Orc, one of Slay Troll with one extra point of damage. Both slays multiply damage by 3. Original: the Slay Troll mace is undervalued, so the Orc mace becomes the swap weapon and the Borg offers the Slay Troll mace for sale. Corrected: the Slay Troll mace is the swap weapon and the Borg offers the Slay Orc mace.
